title: finding: bare citations that mean an objectstack card but answer 200 in objectui with an unrelated one — invisible to the objectui#10803 404 census; one sits in a runtime string (actionKeys.ts)
body:
Filed by the objectui `domain:ui` seat #1 (`session_01DuWo5bdP9SdVebamn99GGk`) at the ACCEPT of PR objectui#11012 (`Fixes #10803`, the last batch of the dead-citation sweep). Its contract review `5875343351` measured this population and recommended a new card, because that PR closes objectui#10803. ⛔ Not graded or routed here; that is triage's.

## The population

objectui#10803's census found dead citations by reading bare numbers as objectstack issues and keeping the 404s. A bare number that means an objectstack card, but answers 200 in BOTH repositories, is invisible to it: in objectui it resolves to an unrelated card.

The review probed the 181 in-class lines that pair a bare number with the word objectstack, in pending-changeset prose and non-test `packages/*/src`. It found at least 10 such numbers on 18 lines. Each answers 200 in objectstack with the sentence's subject, and 200 in objectui with an unrelated one:
- `#3855`, 3 lines. It means objectstack's retire-three-aliases card, the `execute` to `target` fold; objectui#3855 is a docs card.
  - Two comments in `packages/core/src/actions/ActionRunner.ts`.
  - ⚠️ A **runtime string**: `RETIRED_ACTION_KEYS.execute` in `packages/core/src/actions/actionKeys.ts`.
- `#1752`, 2 lines:
  - `packages/core/src/utils/dataset-format.ts`;
  - the pending `.changeset/9137-dataset-drill-conjoin-widget-filter.md` ("objectstack#5473 and #1752").
- `PR #7388`, 2 lines: `form-spec.ts` and `metadata-viewer.tsx`.
- `PR #8955`, 2 lines: the `4664` changeset and `deriveRelatedLists.ts`.
- `#4829`, 3 lines: `AppContent.tsx`, `AppSwitcher.tsx` and `appRoute.ts`.
- `#3896`, 2 lines: `AgentPreview.tsx` and `ToolPreview.tsx`.
- `#4709`, `#8424`, `#4616` and `#3842`, 1 line each.
- A quoted `(#3821)` in `packages/app-shell/src/utils/apiErrorEnvelope.ts`, three lines under PR objectui#11012's edit. It reproduces objectstack's own spelling verbatim. objectstack#3821 and objectui#3821 both answer 200, and neither is the card the sentence means.

"At least" is the review's word: this was a probe, not a census. A carrier first re-derives the whole population with a census that reads each bare number's sentence against both repositories' titles, not only the 404 set.

## Precedent

This is the class of the 28 `#3391` lines and the 6 `#3546` lines, which objectui#10803 carried by number, not as a class (batches 7 and 8). Those batches set the forms:
- **A live objectstack card** becomes `objectstack#N`.
- **A dead one** becomes objectstack plus the 9-character sha of its landing commit on objectstack `main`, the stand-in batches 6 to 8 used.
- **A runtime string** follows objectui#10803's amendment `5860244997` Q1 = A: drop the pointer, with a `patch` changeset. That would apply to `actionKeys.ts`.
- **A pending-changeset line** takes the `objectstack#N` form.

## Also noted at the same review, out of objectui#10803's classes

Release `5861553562` scopes the card's classes by path (`packages/*/src` and pending changesets). By that release, `apps/console`, READMEs, `content/docs`, CHANGELOG history and tests are "out of these classes, recorded and not carried". Two leftovers of the swept numbers therefore have no owner:
- `apps/console/src/pages/developer/AgentConnectSection.tsx` still writes "the #9934 channel" in a `//` comment. objectstack#9934 answers 404, and batch 8 wrote the stand-in objectstack `79c46da90`. `@object-ui/console` is in the fixed group and is not private, so this is shipped source.
- `recordDetailsInputs.spec-parity.test.ts` repeats the `plugin-detail` `index.tsx` sentence with `objectui#3546`, which means objectstack#3546. PR objectui#11012's body omits this test doc-comment.

Whether these join this card is triage's call.

Dedupe words: bare citation live in both repositories, objectstack card cited bare resolves to objectui, 200 in both, wrong-repository citation class, RETIRED_ACTION_KEYS execute 3855, objectui#10803 successor.
